figures.alt: LLaMA training loss continues downward across the reported token budgets. The 7B and 13B curves stop at one trillion tokens; 33B and 65B continue to 1.4 trillion.
figures.caption: Longer training still reduces loss. Reproduced from Touvron et al., Figure 1; figure crop, CC BY 4.0.
figures.purpose: Figure 2 makes the exposure boundary visible: 7B and 13B stop at 1T tokens, while 33B and 65B reach 1.4T. Falling training loss motivates spending more on a model that will later be cheaper to serve; it does not by itself prove equivalent improvement on every downstream task.
